name: Handicapped Students Stipend Mizoram
benefit: - Upto Class 4th - ₹30/- per month per student (360/- per annum) - Class 5th to Class 7th - ₹40/- per month per student (480/- per annum) - Class 8th to Class 12th - ₹85/- per month per student (1020/- per annum)
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Mizoram. 1. The applicant should be a disabled person. 1. The applicant should be a student enrolled in government or private school. 1. The applicant should be from the Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
